title: The Wealth-Destroying Behavior of Retail Option Trading
summary: Introduction to a study of retail option trading around earnings; describes retail traders as lottery buyers whose speculation has been wealth-destroying.

assertions.quote: new research shows just how destructive that type of speculation has been
Is the attraction financially rewarding, or are option buyers, in effect, buying lottery tickets?
The COVID pandemic coincided with a dramatic rise in retail investor participation in options markets.

verdicts.note: Dollar volume of retail-origin (SLAN) and small option trades grew 143% and 224% between Nov 2019 and Jul 2021; strong growth but the data start in 2019 so growth since 2015 is not measured.
